verdict.rationale: An editor like PlayCanvas could plausibly ship in-product AI insights, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack shows none. The MCP server and PlayCanvas Skills let external AI assistants and coding agents drive the Editor. That is adjacent integration plumbing for third-party agents, not AI-generated insights or suggestions delivered inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
